name: Indian Design, Semiconductors, Packaging and Systems (IDSPS)
india_angle: The IDSPS initiative is a national program involving premier Indian institutions and aims to strengthen India's semiconductor R&D and manufacturing capabilities.
summary: IDSPS is a national initiative focused on advancing semiconductor R&D, particularly in advanced packaging, integrated optoelectronics, and power electronics. It collaborates with leading Indian academic institutions and global industry partners to develop manufacturable prototypes and educate a skilled workforce, positioning India as a key player in the semiconductor ecosystem.
